title: Failure Context Hub — Retry Chains, Root-cause Signals & Snapshot Peek
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design an integrated Console surface called 'Failure Context Hub' to help engineers triage failed requests across the Redwood stack. The hub combines a compact retry-chain visualization, ranked root-cause signals, and an inline payload snapshot/peek so users can quickly answer: did this fail due to model error, infra transient, tenant misconfig, or client input? Goal is to reduce mean-time-to-investigate by surfacing context and next-action affordances (replay, re-run with tweak, open PR, annotate), while fitting into the existing request-detail pane and the broader diagnostics workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Hub prototype wireframe integrated into Request Detail: shows retry chain (linear timeline), a ranked list of root-cause signals, and a collapsible payload snapshot.
Signals mapping table available in the design doc that ties UI signals to backend tags (e.g., 'kv-cache-miss', 'model-timeout', 'rate-limit', 'invalid-payload').
Interactions: replay button with modal to edit payload; one-click open to create a GitHub issue with prefilled metadata; annotate / add incident note saved to Logs.
Accessibility: keyboard navigation through retry chain items and screen-reader labels for signal severities.
Design handoff assets (Figma slices + tokens) exported and a short dev checklist created for FE/BE integration.
Usability test with 5 engineers shows median triage time improvement >25% vs current flow (qualitative lab notes captured).
decisions: Prefer inline 'snapshot peek' (collapsed by default) rather than opening a separate viewer to reduce context switching.
Retry chain will show logical retries from client SDK + server-side internal retries; use iconography to distinguish origin.
Root-cause signals are computed by backend heuristics; UI will show confidence score and allow user flagging to improve heuristics.
Opted for lightweight playback (no full deterministic replay) in v1; full deterministic replays considered for later cycle.
Expose 'create-that-issue' affordance but require explicit confirmation modal to avoid noise.
